user.title: Connect Ninestitch
user.description: In Ninestitch, open Household → Home Assistant → Connect Home Assistant. Type the code it shows (it works once, for 10 minutes).

data_description.name: How this Home Assistant appears in Ninestitch.
data_description.url: Leave as it is unless you use a test server.

reauth_confirm.title: Connect {household} again
reauth_confirm.description: This connection was disconnected in Ninestitch, so readings and to-do lists have stopped. Make a new code in Ninestitch (Household → Home Assistant → Connect Home Assistant) and type it here. Readings that waited meanwhile are sent once it's connected.

error.invalid_code: That code isn't right, or it was already used. Check it in Ninestitch. A code made in a test (staging) version only works with that server's address (Advanced mode).
error.expired_code: That code has expired (they last 10 minutes). Make a new one in Ninestitch.
error.rate_limited: Too many wrong codes. Wait a few minutes, then try again.
error.plan_required: Home Assistant is part of Ninestitch Plus. Start the free trial or upgrade in Ninestitch, then make a new code.
error.cannot_connect: Couldn't reach Ninestitch. Check the internet connection and try again.
error.server_not_ready: This Ninestitch server doesn't offer Home Assistant yet. If you made the code in a test (staging) version of Ninestitch, turn on Advanced mode in your Home Assistant profile, then add the integration again and enter that server's address.

abort.wrong_household: That code is for a different household. Make the code in the household that was connected.

plan_required.title: Ninestitch: Home Assistant is paused
plan_required.description: {household} isn't on Ninestitch Plus, so readings, to-do lists and notifications are paused. Readings wait here (up to 24 hours) and are sent once the household is back on Plus. Readings you log yourself in Ninestitch keep working.
